name: u1-base
title: U1 Base Layer
author: bespoked
description:
The doors other Bespok3d plugins knock on. On its own it changes nothing you can see: it opens the printer's print task settings, its RFID reader and its filament detection so that plugins can use them, and it does that in a way that lets several plugins use the same door at once instead of the last one winning.

What it installs:
• U1 Base: print task config, so a plugin can hold off the start-of-print pressure advance reset, and allow a preference to be changed mid print.
• U1 Base: RFID reader, so a plugin can claim and read a card the stock reader does not understand.
• U1 Base: filament detect, so a plugin can read its own spool tags and fill in the filament details.
• U1 Base: resonance tester, so input shaper calibration measures what the printer really does.
• U1 Base: toolhead, so fast moves stay accurate and a little quieter.
• U1 Base: shaper calibrate, so low frequency noise no longer skews a calibration.

Install this because a plugin you want asks for it. Under the hood the three plugins edit Klipper's own program files on the printer. Uninstalling puts the originals back, and they re-apply themselves after a firmware update. Snapmaker U1 only.
tagline: The doors other plugins knock on. Alone it changes nothing.
